title: We've found Sasquatch – USPS Employee News
excerpt: “News Quiz” is a weekly feature that lets you test your knowledge of recent Link stories. The correct answers appear at the end.
content:
“News Quiz” is a weekly feature that lets you test your knowledge of recent Link stories. The correct answers appear at the end.

1. Which of the following is not one of the new stamps coming in 2027?

a) Colorful Blooms

b) Football Legends

c) Halloween

d) Unicorns

2. True or false: A flexible spending account does not carry over into the next year, so employees must re-enroll during open season to continue using the benefit.

a) True

b) False

3. The Postal Service’s total operating expenses for fiscal year 2026 were $89.4 billion, representing which of the following changes compared with the previous year?

a) Decrease of 0.4 percent

b) Increase of 1.7 percent

c) Increase of 3.6 percent

d) Increase of 4.5 percent

4. How much perfume per package are customers permitted to mail?

a) 8 ounces

b) 12 ounces

c) 16 ounces

d) Perfume cannot be sent through the U.S. Mail.

5. Complaints and Inquiry Clerk Mital Patel began climbing tall summits by ascending which of the following?

a) Black Elk Peak in South Dakota

b) Eagle Mountain in Minnesota

c) Humphreys Peak in Arizona

d) Taum Sauk Mountain in Missouri

Answers: 1) b. 2) a. 3) a. 4) c. 5) c.
